NOTE: variants are 3 bullets each (not 4 as task described); rotation index = (startIdx-from-slug-hash + viewCount) % 5, showing VARIANTS[3] (The-second-winemaker) — rotation is deterministic + working.

issues: Theme picker overlay 'CHOOSE YOUR WORKING LIGHT' still intercepts pointer events on cards below it (carried over from iter30). During cold-call demos a visitor lands on /join and the overlay covers the bottom of Card 01. Consider auto-dismissing after 6s, or making it a right-side edge nudge rather than a centred modal on first-load.

Preview environment routes HTML to Vite dev server → static og:title 'Ownology — Cellar Intelligence…' rather than the per-slug question. This is expected in preview and verified fixed on direct-Express (localhost:8001) hit, so production ownology.ai will inject correctly. Only flagging so E1 remembers to sanity-check share previews on the real ownology.ai host once DNS is cut over.

critical_code_review_comments: HiContact.tsx line 161-192: task/PRD description says '4 bullet items per variant' but VARIANTS array has 3 bullets per row. Not a bug — rotation and content are strong — but E1 should either (a) update the internal spec to 3 bullets, or (b) add a 4th bullet per variant if the intent was 4. Currently 3 renders cleanly on mobile; 4 might over-crowd.

client/src/components/AdminQrBadge.tsx line 61 uses window.open with _blank + noopener,noreferrer — correct. But because it's a <button> not <a>, right-click 'open in new tab' behaviour is lost and middle-click doesn't work either. For admin trade-show use where a rep might want to preview vs. actually open, a <a target=_blank> would be marginally friendlier.

server/index.ts line 727 dynamic OG for /cellar-journal/:slug is correct code but the k8s ingress in preview routes HTML → Vite (:3000) — so QA cannot verify the OG injection through the preview URL, only through direct localhost:8001 or the production ownology.ai host. Documented already in iter30 comments.

Rate limiter on /api/gate/verify (5 attempts/15min/IP) fired during automated testing at /cellar-brief unlock — testing agent had already unlocked /admin/members and /tasting on same session. Consider bumping to 10/15min for the shared preview environment, OR resetting the in-memory bucket on backend restart with a documented dev-mode helper endpoint. Not a production blocker.
test_credentials: OWNOLOGY_GATE_PASSWORD=middx99 (used to unlock /admin/members and /tasting). Dev-bypass active in preview (auto-authenticated as seed admin richard@ownology.ai) so ownerProcedure endpoints all pass.
seed_data_creation: None added this iteration. One /ask public question was submitted ('What is the ideal fermentation temperature for Pinot Noir?') which persisted as a Cellar Journal entry at /cellar-journal/fermentation-what-is-the-ideal-fermentation-temperature-for-pinot-noir — not TEST-prefixed because it's a real winemaking question and adds legitimate content. Also submitted one /tasting entry for tank T7 (vintage_log_entries row with details_json.tasting) which will be picked up by the next cellar brief generation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is cold-call-ready. All marketing-critical flows (/join, /join/landscape, /join/qr, /ask, /cellar-journal permalinks, /pwa/install, /hi/:slug, /admin/members) work end-to-end. Two known preview-only environmental quirks documented above and unchanged from iter30: (1) theme picker overlay intercepts clicks — use force=True in Playwright; (2) preview k8s ingress routes HTML → Vite so Express-side OG injection + trial-tier redirects can only be verified via direct localhost:8001 curl. If you hit gate-verify rate limit (5/15min), restart backend (in-memory buckets) or wait — do NOT interpret as a code bug. tRPC v11 GET query format is {batch=1&input=%7B%220%22%3A%7B%22json%22%3A%7B...%7D%7D%7D} — the un-batched shape returns 400.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Full-site sweep confirms all 16 target flows work and the site is safe to open to cold-call marketing.
